legend: A case showing the frequent t(8;13) rearrangement. FISH with a break-apart probe for the detection of FGFR1 rearrangements (telomeric 3′ probe labelled in red; centromeric 5′ probe labelled in green): three interphase nuclei show a separation of one green and one red signal indicating a translocation involving the FGFR1 locus, and one green/red colocalization signal representing the intact FGFR1 locus; one interphase nucleus shows two green/red colocalization signals representing two intact FGFR1 loci (normal signal constellation) (<<36687>>). G-banded karyogram of a case with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm harbouring a t(8;13)(p11.2;q12.1) translocation involving FGFR1, as confirmed by FISH (<<36686>>).
